infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: ExpiryGo needs camera access to scan expiration dates and product barcodes with AI.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: ExpiryGo needs your location to show nearby grocery and bakery discounts.
